THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 OF CR.PC (FILED U/S 528 BNSS) PRAYING TO QUASH THE PROCEEDINGS IN CC.NO.24156/2023 ARISING OUT OF CR.NO.366/2018 OF R.T.NAGAR POLICE STATION,
PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTION 498A R/W 34 OF IPC,
WHICH IS PENDING ON THE FILE OF 32ND ACMM AT BENGALURU.

THESE PETITIONS COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.P.SANDESH  ORAL ORDER

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, the learned High Court Government Pleader for No.1 and learned counsel for respondent No.2 and the parties are also present before the Court.
NC: 2025:KHC:14709 2.

These two criminal petitions are filed before this Court praying to quash the proceedings initiated against the petitioners in both the cases, who have been arraigned as accused Nos.1 to 3 and these two cases are registered against the respective petitioners in C.C.Nos.3090/2019 and 24156/2023.
3.
The parties have filed joint memo and also joint application before this Court invoking Section 320 read with Section 482 Cr.P.C. praying this Court to quash the proceedings.

In terms of the joint Masood Ahmed vs The State Of Karnataka on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183740813/
3 application, the respondent No.2 has agreed to withdraw the case in C.Misc.No.6/2019 which is pending for consideration for awarding maintenance and respondent No.2 has received Rs.5,00,000/- by way of Demand Draft bearing No.207389 from husband towards maintenance of children, permanent alimony and as full and final settlement.

entities.text: Masood Ahmed vs The State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The respondent No.2 has no claim in future and she undertakes that she will not file civil or criminal or any maintenance case against the petitioners in future and also undertakes to withdraw C.Mis.No.6/2019.

The respondent No.2 is present before the Court and has received Demand Draft for Rs.5,00,000/- and respondent No.2 has acknowledged receipt of the said amount and learned counsel for respondent No.2 has also identified respondent No.2 before the Court.

In view of acknowledging receipt of amount of Rs.5,00,000/- in terms of Demand Draft and in view of joint memo filed by the parties, the joint memo is taken on record, the proceedings initiated against the petitioners herein in both the cases is hereby quashed and the respondent No.2 is directed to withdraw the case which is pending before the Trial Court within two weeks from today as undertaken in the joint memo.
Accordingly, the criminal petitions stands disposed of.
Pending I.As, if any stand disposed of.

Sd/-
